simple.meaning: דַּרְדַּר (dardar) is a Hebrew word meaning “a thorn.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דַּרְדַּר (H1863) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 3:18, with occurrences in Genesis, Hosea.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דַּרְדַּר (H1863) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דַּרְדַּר (H1863) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דַּרְדַּר (dardar) / H1863 is traced through Genesis 3:18, Hosea 10:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
